title: For Families Moving to Larkspur Assisted Living — The Care Transition Courtesy on the Independent Living Final Month
content:
A resident moving from an Independent Living Residency Agreement into Larkspur assisted living receives a care transition courtesy on the final month's independent living base fee charge, by the care level of the resident's active Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.

## The courtesy

| Care level of the active Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement | Care transition courtesy |
|---|---|
| Assisted Living Care Level 4, Assisted Living Care Level 5 or Assisted Living Care Level 6 | 10.0 percent |
| Assisted Living Care Level 1, Assisted Living Care Level 2 or Assisted Living Care Level 3 | 5.0 percent |
| No active Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement | None |

The care level is the level shown on the customer's assisted living residency whose status is active.

## How the courtesy is applied

The courtesy percentage reduces the final month's base fee charge before rounding. Where other courtesy percentages also apply to the charge, every courtesy percentage is added into one total and the charge is reduced once by that total — never one courtesy after another — and the result is rounded once to the cent half up.

## Examples for families (hypothetical figures)

- A parent whose assisted living residency is active at Assisted Living Care Level 5, with a final month's charge of 1,200.00 before rounding and no other courtesy: 1,200.00 reduced by 10.0 percent, that is 1,080.00.
- The same charge with this 10.0 percent and another courtesy of 2.0 percent: the total of 12.0 percent reduces 1,200.00 once, to 1,056.00.
- A parent whose assisted living admission is still pending, with no active assisted living residency: no care transition courtesy.
